title: Cannot put comma at the end of a callable lambda parameter that ends on a match branch
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on master (eda2a482e9ce82e4056cfffae0ea98c1954605a1)

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (eda2a482e) - macOS Tahoe (26.6.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads) - 48.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The following code triggers a GDScriptParser error despite being technically OK: `Parse Error: Expected expression for match pattern.`

```gdscript
extends Node

func _ready() -> void:
	Inner \
			.new("test") \
			._accepting_lambdas(
				func() -> void:
					match 123:
						123:
							var _hello: = "world",
			)


class Inner extends Node:
	func _init(_p_test: String) -> void:
		pass


	func _accepting_lambdas(_p_lambda: Callable) -> void:
		pass

```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a function that accepts a callable as a parameter.
2. Call that function and pass a lambda as a parameter.
3. Make that lambda end with a match branch.
